          SPECIFICATION
          
Technical Notes

          
Uses TextEncoder UTF-8 byte arrays to safely Base64-encode Unicode characters without `btoa` Latin1 exceptions.

          
Frequently Asked Questions

          
Why does standard JavaScript btoa() fail on Armenian or emoji characters?
Standard `btoa()` only accepts 8-bit Latin1 characters. Converting through `TextEncoder` UTF-8 bytes ensures multi-byte Unicode strings encode accurately.
